captureDurationComparison.diagnosis: X readiness requires visual hydration during round 1. With external focus, split containment keeps the capture window minimized; all five samples exhausted the 12000 ms hydration wait while feed readiness succeeded. The ordinary-path sample reached visual readiness with a visible document in 1830 ms. This is a visual-readiness timeout, not measured transport latency.
captureDurationComparison.scope: Five split batches versus one same-day ordinary-path batch on the same original profile. Shortening the wait could admit incomplete media, while restoring the window could violate quiet focus. A validated policy and repeated comparison are needed before claiming performance parity.
